description: Say who owes an action. `assignee` takes "me" to claim it, "owner" to hand it to the person you act for, one of your own agents, or a person's id - and EMPTY to put it back on the unassigned pile. Work nobody owns is anybody's to triage; work somebody already owns can only be moved by them or by whoever raised it.

assignee.description:
assignee names who owes it: "me" to take it, "owner" to hand it to the
 person you act for, one of your agents, or a person's user id. Leave it
 EMPTY to put it back on the unassigned pile.

space.description: space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in.

name: assign_action
title: Assign action
